## What's new

- **A Telegram bot.** TurboDL can take orders from your phone through a Telegram bot of your own, for example while it runs on a computer somewhere else. The bot is part of the app: it works while TurboDL runs, needs no open port, and is off until you set it up.
  - **Setup.** Create a bot with [@BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather), save its token in **Settings → Telegram** (or `turbodl telegram token`), then pair your chat: **Pair** in Settings or `turbodl telegram pair` shows a 6-digit code to send the bot as `/start <code>`. That chat is bound and the bot turns on.
  - **Send a username** (`nasa`, `@nasa`) or a profile link: the bot asks what to save (Posts, Highlights, Tagged, Photos, Videos, ticked as in the app) and backs the profile up when you press Start.
  - **Send several usernames, or a `.txt`** with one profile per line: the same choices plus the wait between profiles, then a profile list.
  - **Send any other link** (an Instagram post, reel, story or highlight, YouTube, a file): it downloads at once, at the best quality.
  - **`/status`, `/stop`, `/list`, `/help`.** What is running and the Instagram sign-in, Stop buttons, the list's message with Stop, Continue and Close.
  - Each download gets one message that updates itself while it runs, then a short reply when it ends: the files saved and their folder, or why it failed. Files stay on the computer running TurboDL; Telegram only gets status messages.
  - The bot answers only the bound private chat. Messages and button presses from anyone else, and from groups, get no reply at all.
  - After TurboDL restarts, the bot says so in the messages of what was running, and a list that was running offers Continue.
  - Instagram Saved collections can't be backed up from Telegram yet; use the app for those. The Instagram sign-in happens in the app on that computer (or `turbodl instagram login`).
  - The token is stored encrypted by the system (where it can't be, in a file only you can read) and never shown again.
- **Command line and local API.** `turbodl telegram status | token | chat <id> | pair | unpair | on | off`, and `GET /v1/telegram` with `POST /v1/telegram/token`, `/chat`, `/enabled` and `/pair`. `GET /v1/info` lists the `telegram` feature.

## Updating

- Install the new version over the old one and open TurboDL once. Nothing else changes until you set up the bot.
- **Extension.** Unchanged in this version; nothing to do.
- **Firefox.** Open `TurboDL-Firefox-0.10.0.xpi` in Firefox. Regular Firefox only installs add-ons signed by Mozilla. If this file is unsigned, use Firefox Developer Edition, Nightly or ESR with `xpinstall.signatures.required` set to `false`.
- **Linux.** `sudo apt install ./TurboDL-0.10.0-amd64.deb`, or replace the AppImage and start it once from its new place. On a computer without a desktop keyring, the bot token is kept in a file only your user can read.
- **Python.** `turbodl-client` 0.4.0 works unchanged; it has no Telegram calls.

The Windows installer is not signed yet: choose **More info → Run anyway**.
